title: Aerospace Engineers
description: Perform engineering duties in designing, constructing, and testing aircraft, missiles, and spacecraft. May conduct basic and applied research to evaluate adaptability of materials and equipment to aircraft design and manufacture. May recommend improvements in testing equipment and techniques.

tasks.text: Formulate conceptual design of aeronautical or aerospace products or systems to meet customer requirements or conform to environmental regulations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts electromechanical designs; engineer verifies

dwas.name: Design electromechanical equipment or systems.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Evaluate product data or design from inspections or reports for conformance to engineering principles, customer requirements, environmental regulations, or quality standards.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Design quality evaluation needs engineering judgment

dwas.name: Evaluate designs or specifications to ensure quality.

tasks.text: Direct or coordinate activities of engineering or technical personnel involved in designing, fabricating, modifying, or testing of aircraft or aerospace products.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing design work needs accountability and judgment

tasks.text: Plan or conduct experimental, environmental, operational, or stress tests on models or prototypes of aircraft or aerospace systems or equipment.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI interprets results; human runs physical tests

dwas.name: Test performance of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or integrated systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Diagnose performance problems by reviewing reports or documentation from customers or field engineers or by inspecting malfunctioning or damaged products.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Failure data analysis aided; physical inspection human

dwas.name: Investigate system, equipment, or product failures.

tasks.text: Formulate mathematical models or other methods of computer analysis to develop, evaluate, or modify design, according to customer engineering requirements.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI builds computational models; engineer validates assumptions

dwas.name: Create models of engineering designs or methods.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Write technical reports or other documentation, such as handbooks or bulletins, for use by engineering staff, management, or customers.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft procedural documents from provided content

tasks.text: Maintain records of performance reports for future reference.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain records systems; human owns integrity

dwas.name: Maintain operational records or records systems.

tasks.text: Analyze project requests, proposals, or engineering data to determine feasibility, productibility, cost, or production time of aerospace or aeronautical products.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Analyzes design/requirements data; engineer owns judgment

dwas.name: Analyze design or requirements information for mechanical equipment or systems.

tasks.text: Plan or coordinate investigation and resolution of customers' reports of technical problems with aircraft or aerospace vehicles.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing QC needs human oversight of physical processes

tasks.text: Develop design criteria for aeronautical or aerospace products or systems, including testing methods, production costs, quality standards, environmental standards, or completion dates.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Design criteria drafted; human owns decisions

dwas.name: Determine design criteria or specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Direct aerospace research and development programs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing design work needs accountability and judgment

tasks.text: Evaluate and approve selection of vendors by studying past performance or new advertisements.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Gather performance info, human validates sources

tasks.text: Research new materials to determine quality or conformance to environmental standards.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Regulation-to-compliance mapping; human verifies

dwas.name: Monitor operational procedures in technical environments to ensure conformance to standards.
Evaluate plans or specifications to determine technological or environmental implications.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

dwas.name: Analyze environmental regulations to ensure organizational compliance.

emerging_tasks.task: Develop and test autonomous systems for uncrewed aerospace vehicles.
